text:
michelle: Heads-up — we're seeing elevated latency and intermittent 502s from token-db in us-west1 affecting generation and embeddings traffic. Impacting ~12% of requests since ~10:02 PDT. Investigating. :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2345 created by michelle. Pager duty: @alex oncall. Severity: P1. Link: https://incident.redwood.ai/INC-2345

alex: I'm on it. Observed CPU + iowait spikes on token-db-3, disk stats look noisy. Starting a rolling restart of that node now.

carter: Seeing customer error reports from 5 prod accounts. Notifying support to surface to customers and collect hit patterns. @product-ops

eng-ml: Temporarily throttling long-sequence embedding jobs at the gateway to reduce KV pressure. Rule: `--max-emb-reqs=20` applied.

michelle: Mitigation update — restarted token-db-3; preliminary p95 latency dropped from ~800ms to ~120ms. Error rate downstream still ~1.8%. Continuing to monitor.

sre-team: Adding a read-replica to the cluster to absorb reads. Also tracing a few slow KV scans. Canary traffic for generation endpoints is returning to green.

product-ops: Published initial status page update: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2345 — customer advisory in draft, will share once approved.

alex: Root cause hypothesis: compaction backlog + sudden increase in long-lived KV scans from a third-party customer job. Plan: tune compaction params and limit concurrent scans. Applying `max_scan_workers=10` as hotfix and monitoring.

michelle: Current service state: partial degradation -> improving. Customer impact reduced but not fully resolved. ETA for stabilization: 30–45m. Next update in 30m or sooner if anything changes.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: compaction-tune v1.2 -> token-db-cluster (rolling).

carter: Thanks team — triage notes + mitigations documented on INC-2345. Will assign postmortem owner after we've hit steady-state.
